description: This file contains Unicode-aware string helper functions under the namespace 'Opencart.System.Helper.Utf8', including functions for string length, position, substring, and case conversion, designed to work with UTF-8 encoded strings.

classes.name: Opencart.System.Helper.Utf8
classes.description: A namespace grouping UTF-8 string helper functions for the OpenCart system.

methods.name: strlen
methods.description: Returns the length of a UTF-8 encoded string using mb_strlen.

methods.name: strpos
methods.description: Finds the position of the first occurrence of a substring in a UTF-8 string using mb_strpos.

methods.name: strrpos
methods.description: Finds the position of the last occurrence of a substring in a UTF-8 string using mb_strrpos.

methods.name: substr
methods.description: Returns a substring of a UTF-8 string using mb_substr.

methods.name: strtoupper
methods.description: Converts a UTF-8 string to uppercase using mb_strtoupper.

methods.name: strtolower
methods.description: Converts a UTF-8 string to lowercase using mb_strtolower.
